name: Protecting Israel
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign promise to protect Israel, blessing those who bless His chosen people and cursing those who oppose them, as seen in Genesis 12:3 and Numbers 24:9. God's protection is linked to Israel's faithfulness to His commandments, which leads to exaltation above all nations (Deuteronomy 28:1). Believers are called to intercede earnestly for Jerusalem's peace (Psalms 122:6) and to trust that God will silence and defeat those who rise against Israel (Psalms 83:1; Isaiah 41:11). This divine safeguarding underscores God's faithfulness to His covenant and His purpose to bless all families of the earth through Israel.
